title.hinglish: Confirm karo ki site HTTP/2 bolti hai

why.en: curl asks for h2 through ALPN and prints which protocol version was used.
why.hinglish: curl ALPN se h2 maangta hai aur print karta hai ki kaun sa protocol version use hua.

expect.en: Prints 2 when HTTP/2 was negotiated (or 3 if your curl prefers HTTP/3). It depends on the server and your curl build.
expect.hinglish: HTTP/2 negotiate hone par 2 print hota hai (ya 3 agar tumhara curl HTTP/3 prefer kare). Yeh server aur tumhare curl build par depend karta hai.

title.en: See the h2 negotiation in detail

why.en: Verbose output shows the ALPN result and the HTTP/2 streams curl opens.
why.hinglish: Verbose output ALPN ka result aur curl dwara kholi gayi HTTP/2 streams dikhata hai.

expect.en: A line like “ALPN: server accepted h2” and “using HTTP/2”, then a request on Stream ID 1 with :method and :path pseudo-headers. Exact text varies by curl version.
expect.hinglish: “ALPN: server accepted h2” aur “using HTTP/2” jaisi line, phir Stream ID 1 par :method aur :path pseudo-headers wali request. Exact text curl version ke hisaab se badalta hai.

title.en: List the HTTP/2 frames in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein HTTP/2 frames list karo

why.en: The lesson capture is decrypted, so Wireshark shows every frame with its stream number.
why.hinglish: Lesson capture decrypted hai, isliye Wireshark har frame ko uske stream number ke saath dikhata hai.

expect.en: SETTINGS, WINDOW_UPDATE, HEADERS and DATA frames. Look for stream IDs 1, 3 and 5 in the main scenario.
expect.hinglish: SETTINGS, WINDOW_UPDATE, HEADERS aur DATA frames. Main scenario mein stream IDs 1, 3 aur 5 dekho.

why.en: Filtering on a stream number isolates a single request and its response from the others.
why.hinglish: Stream number par filter karne se ek request aur uska response baaki se alag ho jaata hai.

expect.en: Only the frames of stream 3: the HEADERS for /style.css and its response. Frames of other streams are hidden.
expect.hinglish: Sirf stream 3 ke frames: /style.css ka HEADERS aur uska response. Doosri streams ke frames chhup jaate hain.
